title: Gentle web models screen
brief: Model, effort and profile open from the chat (status bar chips and /gentle:profiles) into their own models screen that mirrors gentle-shell's: profiles as tabs, a table with the orchestrator and agents, and Use in this session, Make default and Save.

artboards.title: From the chat
artboards.tradeoff: Status bar chips open a small summary with one action; the slash menu offers /gentle:profiles. Keeps the chat clean, adds one click before editing

artboards.title: Models screen
artboards.tradeoff: Faithful to gentle-shell: profile tabs, one table, three buttons that say where a change applies. Dense, with more concepts to learn than a single model picker

artboards.title: States and confirmations
artboards.tradeoff: Everything that can go wrong or needs a yes: Make default diff, unsaved changes, delete, loading, empty, save error and unavailable provider
